visualCharacteristics: Stacked list of bold questions separated by rules, each with a chevron; clicking expands the answer below. One list per FAQ group, each preceded by an orange group heading. Option 'single-open': opening an item closes the others in the same block (native details name group).
contentPattern: One row per question. Cell 1: question text. Cell 2: answer (paragraphs, lists, links). Group heading (H3) is default content placed before each block.

options.label: Single open (one item at a time)

usage: Seguro Protege Casa 'Ficou com alguma duvida?' FAQ: general (10), Coberturas (13), Atendimento (5), Assistencia (2), Assistencia Pet (4), Sorteios (4).
reuseGuidance: Use for any Q&A list. Built on native details/summary, so it is keyboard and screen-reader accessible without extra script. Use one block per FAQ group with the group heading as default content before it. A URL hash matching an id inside an item opens that item.
